subject.title: Add Model and Token Usage Status Display to Control UI Topbar

question: Should the Control UI add a persistent topbar model/token/provider-usage status, and if so which canonical state should it display?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but placement, data freshness, token-versus-quota meaning, and responsive density require maintainer UX/product intent before implementation.

options.title: Define a compact topbar contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the model, token/context, provider quota, stale, unavailable, and responsive behavior before implementation.

options.title: Decline topbar placement
options.body: Close after maintainer decision and document Chat, Usage, Overview, `/status`, and `/usage` as the supported visibility surfaces.

options.title: Split token work to chat
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62167 for chat-specific token/quota widgets and leave active-model topbar status out of scope.

recommendation.title: Define a compact topbar contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the model, token/context, provider quota, stale, unavailable, and responsive behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent Control UI shell history and prior review context on this exact product placement question.
